reason: I already have my café; they know my order and I get a proper seat there. A $7.50 cheesecake matcha I'd have to drink standing at a subway exit isn't enough to pull me away.
objection: Nowhere to sit. 'A few seats' inside someone else's shop at a busy subway exit sounds like I'd be holding a pricey drink on the sidewalk.
would_change_my_mind: Being sure of a real seat on a weekend morning. Then I might try one of the signature drinks once as a treat.
